messages:
irina: Heads-up — PM asked we make canary cost cards show token spend vs cache impact. Totals keep hiding big KV wins. Screenshot: https://our.internal/snap.png :eyes:

ben: Strong yes. If the card shows 'tokens_billed' and 'cache_saved_tokens' per-variant + a normalized metric (net_delta_per_1k_invokes) we can compare canaries with different traffic shapes.

sid: Implementation idea: producers emit a compact snapshot at snapshot_time. One aggregate row per route+variant containing: route, variant, invocations, tokens_billed, cache_saved_tokens, unit_price_cents, net_cost_cents, baseline_snapshot_id, approx(boolean), sample_size, reasons[] (enum), note. Keep it small to avoid re-ingesting full timeseries.

zoe: UX notes: render paired bars where token spend is red and cache savings are green (display as a reduction). Add toggle: per-invocation vs per-token averages and a per-1k normalized delta. Tooltip shows exact cents and token counts. Add CSV export.

ben: Heuristics must be explainable. Proposal: if variant_id != baseline -> model_swap; if median tokens shift >25% -> token_shift; if prompt overlap <60% -> prompt_change. Produce a confidence score from sample_size and magnitude.

sid: Telemetry contract sketch: POST /internal/v1/canary_snapshots accepts compact JSON array of rows. Snapshots are signed with rollout_id+ts and stored as an immutable blob for audit. Default retention 90d, enterprise can request longer. If producer can't fully aggregate, allow approx=true and include sample_size; UI should surface "approximate" badge.

irina: Product asks for an "explain" pill on the card showing top_reason + confidence and an expand that displays token histograms and a one-line explanation. Also want an option to choose baseline snapshot for delta calculation.

ops-bot: snapshot recorded rollout=canary-2026-03-30T14:20Z by @irina

sid: Action items: sid -> draft endpoint + example payloads + aggregator SQL (ETA Tue), ben -> mock UI + CSV export (ETA Wed), zoe -> tooltip and per-1k spec, irina -> update rollout runbook and retention request. I'll mark snapshot blobs immutable and include signature metadata.

ben: Example aggregator SQL for producer-side aggregation:
```
SELECT route, variant, count(*) AS invocations,
       sum(tokens) AS tokens_billed,
       sum(cache_saved) AS cache_saved_tokens,
       sum(tokens * unit_price_cents) AS net_cost_cents
FROM invocation_telemetry
WHERE rollout_id = :rollout_id AND snapshot_bucket = :snapshot_ts
GROUP BY route, variant;
```

zoe: Keeping this thread as the decision log. :thumbsup:
